text: The current speed limit on Dovercourt Road, between Dundas Street West and Queen Street West is 40 km/h. This section of Dovercourt Road is heavily used by motorists and pedestrians to travel to multiple local schools and a community centre. Residents in both of our respective Wards have raised safety concerns over excessive traffic volumes and speeding on Dovercourt Road. As traffic incidents are dramatically reduced when vehicles operate at 30 km/h, the purpose of this motion seeks to lower the current speed limit on Dovercourt Road, between Dundas and Queen Street West, from 40 km/h to 30 km/h.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to reduce the speed limit on Dovercourt Road, between Dundas Street West and Queen Street West, from 40 km/h to 30 km/h.
